card.statement:
Let $s\in\N^\ast$, let $R_1,\dots,R_s$ be commutative $\k$-algebras and consider the $\k$-algebra $R = R_1\otimes\dots\otimes R_s$.

- For $1 \le i \le s$, let $\phi_i\in\widehat{R_i}$. The $\k$-linear map

\[
\begin{array}{ccrcl}
\phi_1 \dots \phi_s & : & R & \longrightarrow & \k \cr
& & x_1 \otimes\dots\otimes x_s & \mapsto & \phi_1(x_1) \dots \phi_s(x_s)
\end{array}
\]

is a morphism of $\k$-algebras. Furthermore, we have that

\[
\ker(\phi_1 \dots \phi_s) = W
\]

where

\[
W=\ker(\phi_1) \otimes R_2 \otimes\dots\otimes R_s
+ R_1 \otimes \ker(\phi_2) \otimes\dots\otimes R_s + \dots + R_1 \otimes\dots\otimes R_{s-1} \otimes \ker(\phi_s).
\]

- The map

\[
\begin{array}{ccrcl}
& & \widehat{R_1} \times\dots\times \widehat{R_s} & \longrightarrow & \widehat{R} \cr
& & (\phi_1 , \dots , \phi_s) & \mapsto & \phi_1 \dots \phi_s
\end{array}
\]

is bijective.
card.label: Proposition 10

paper.title: \titre
paper.abstract: We develop a general framework for studying relative weight representations for certain pairs consisting of an associative algebra and a commutative subalgebra. Using these tools we describe projective and simple weight modules for quantum Weyl algebras for generic values of deformation parameters. We consider two quantum versions: one by Maltsiniotis and the other one by Akhavizadegan and Jordan.

macros.titre: Weight modules of quantized Weyl algebras
